people.name: Nile
people.line: The major river of Egypt, mentioned in various contexts

translations.web: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.
translations.bsb: Then the fishermen will mourn, all who cast a hook into the Nile will lament, and those who spread nets on the waters will pine away.
translations.kjv: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
translations.asv: And the fishers shall lament, and all they that cast angle into the Nile shall mourn, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
